p: that time Jesus went on the: Of the true sanctifying of the sabbath, and the breaking of it.
shewbread: The Hebrews call it "bread of faces", because it stood before the Lord all the week upon the golden table appointed for that service; Le 24:6.
profane the sabbath: When the priests do God's service on the sabbath day, they do not break the law: much less does the Lord of the Sabbath break the sabbath.
And when he was departed thence: The ceremonies of the law are not against the love of our neighbour.
Then the Pharisees went out: How far and in what aspect we may give place to the unbridled rage of the wicked.

judgment to the Gentiles: By judgment is meant a godly kingdom, because Christ was to proclaim true religion among the Gentiles, and to cast out superstition; and wherever this is done, the Lord is said to reign and judge there, that is to say, to govern and rule matters.
send forth judgment unto victory: He will pronounce sentence and judgment, in spite of the world and Satan, and show himself conqueror over all his enemies.
Then was brought unto him one: A truth, be it ever so obvious, is subject to the slander of the wicked: however, it ought to be resolutely defended.
And Jesus knew their thoughts: The kingdom of Christ and the kingdom of the devil cannot abide together.
but whosoever speaketh against the Holy: Of blasphemy against the Holy Spirit.
O generation of vipers: Hypocrites at length betray themselves even by their own mouth.
idle word that men shall speak: Vain and unprofitable trifles, which for the most part, men spend their lives in search of.
Then certain of the scribes and: Against perverse desires of miracles.
adulterous generation seeketh after a sign: Bastard, who fell from Abraham's faith or forsook the true worship of God.
The men of Nineveh shall rise: Christ teaches, by the sorrowful example of the Jews, that there are none more miserable than they who put out the light of the gospel which was kindled in them.
south shall rise up in the: He means the Queen of Sheba: whose country is south in respect to the land of Israel; 1Ki 10:1-13.
uttermost parts of the earth to: For Sheba is situated in the farthest coast of Arabia at the mouth of the Arabian Sea.
While he yet talked to the: Christ teaches by his own example that all things ought to be set aside in respect of God's glory.
And he stretched forth his hand: None are more near unto us than they that are of the household of faith.
